issues.passage: Prolonged strife among the partners produced an unusually stable alliance.
issues.why: "Strife among the partners" is standard correct use (bitter conflict). A paradoxical outcome (stable alliance) does not make the word itself wrong; a careful reader would accept the sentence as valid English.

fix.correctPassage: Years of regional strife disrupted trade along the mountain routes.
wrongPassages: After years of strife, the rivals had never once quarreled or disagreed.
The strife of the quiet library made it ideal for uninterrupted study.
They valued the strife of a household where no one ever argued.
